name: Roger Samuelsson
current_role: Founder and majority owner (~68%), SHL Medical (Zug, Switzerland)
profile: Swedish entrepreneur who moved to Taiwan in 1988 and in 1989 co-founded SHL Group (now SHL Medical) with Martin Jelf; it grew into the world's largest maker of autoinjectors, supplying Novo Nordisk, Amgen, Pfizer and others. EQT holds roughly a third of the company. He also owns the 414-ft yacht Octopus, formerly Paul Allen's.
interesting_fact: He owns Octopus, the 414-foot explorer megayacht originally built for Microsoft cofounder Paul Allen.
deep_cut_fact: As a young amateur boxer, Samuelsson first visited Taiwan in 1983 out of curiosity to see where his boxing equipment was made; with a Swedish mechanical engineering degree he later returned to source merchandise for European importers before starting SHL.
notes: Press-shy; Forbes reports he declined multiple interview requests. Best route is SHL Medical communications (Carl Gillblad listed as media contact in releases).
